content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR IARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technical staff: Graduation in any stream from a recognized College/University. Desirable: In science stream preferably. Experience in lab or field experiment, extension work, knowledge of computer, and experience in survey work. Able to speak Nepali/Bengali beside Hindi and English. Semi-skilled worker: 10th pass. Desirable: Work experience in field survey, sample collection, and Knowledge in basic computer application (MS-Office). Able to speak Nepali/Bengali beside Hindi and English. Age Limit Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation: five years for SC/ST & women and three years for OBC as per GoI norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 is 07-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Assistant posts, divided into two categories: Technical staff (1 post) and Semi-skilled worker (1 post).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical staff position?
faq.answer: For the Technical staff position, candidates need to have a Graduation in any stream from a recognized College/University. A science stream background is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Semi-skilled worker post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Semi-skilled worker position is Rs. 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening, followed by a Walk-in Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Kalimpong, West Bengal. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification mentions the location as Kalimpong, West Bengal. While not explicitly stated, candidates from other states may apply if they meet all eligibility criteria and can attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.
